summary: A neighbor who shares your worry asks you to come to the posted town meeting about it.
realLife: Residents who opposed a housing plan filled a town hearing; a petition against it reportedly drew close to 2,000 signatures, and neighbors turned out together.
sources: WSOC-TV, hundreds at Weddington town hearing: https://www.wsoctv.com/news/local/development-debate-brings-hundreds-raucous-weddington-town-meeting/BATFRWXP6NCZFBC2CEMHZBD7IY
inGame: a cause-shared record between the player and the neighbor (topic a policy question, budget line or illness) leading to an invitation to a posted meeting of the town's body; the meeting is the body's posted session

turns.summary: The neighbor offers to walk over with you and sit together.
turns.writesBack: tie warms; attendance noted in journal

turns.summary: The neighbor mentions the meeting only the afternoon it happens.
turns.writesBack: a missed chance; mild guilt mood

turns.summary: You say you will read about it instead and stay home.
turns.writesBack: tie cools slightly; the neighbor goes alone
